answer: A bond of 21% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in falcon, and relic reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 191 aliases, and each one needs its own funded echo account. A farm of 1918 identities would post 1178 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
